column1: # Cases where the decoder of this crate does not read a probe as Saxon-HE 12.10 and xmllint
# (libxml2 2.9.14) both do, with the reason: the reference parsers disagree and the decoder
# refuses the document, or both read it in an encoding the decoder does not read.
# tests/encoding.rs fails on any other difference and on any listed case that no longer differs.

column2: A UTF-16 byte order mark and a declaration naming UTF-8: xmllint reads UTF-16, Saxon-HE refuses the document. Refused (Error::EncodingMismatch).
As utf16le/bom-decl-utf-8, without a byte order mark (the first bytes are `<?` in UTF-16).
ISO-10646-UCS-2: Saxon-HE reads it as UTF-16, xmllint does not support it. Refused as unsupported.
The name UTF16 after a UTF-16LE byte order mark: xmllint reads it, Saxon-HE refuses it. Refused as unsupported.
The name UTF16 after a UTF-16BE byte order mark: both read it, but not in the other byte order (utf16le/bom-decl-utf16-no-dash), so the name is not one the decoder accepts. Refused as unsupported.
An unpaired high surrogate at the end of the document: xmllint ignores it, Saxon-HE refuses the document. Refused (Error::InvalidEncodedBytes).
An odd number of bytes, the last one after the document element: xmllint ignores it, Saxon-HE refuses the document. Refused (Error::InvalidEncodedBytes).
A name of UTF-8 that Saxon-HE accepts and xmllint does not support. Refused as unsupported.
Shift_JIS, read by both: an encoding the decoder does not read. Refused as unsupported.
As utf8/bom-decl-Shift_JIS-ascii (both read the bytes after the UTF-8 byte order mark as Shift_JIS).
A Java name of ISO-8859-1: Saxon-HE accepts it, xmllint does not support it. Refused as unsupported.
A name of ISO-8859-1 that xmllint accepts (iconv) and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
A name of ISO-8859-15 that Saxon-HE accepts and xmllint does not support. Refused as unsupported.
A name of ISO-8859-15 that xmllint accepts (iconv) and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
A name of windows-1252 that xmllint accepts (iconv) and Saxon-HE does not. Refused as unsupported.
A byte that is no character in windows-1252: Saxon-HE reads U+FFFD in its place, xmllint refuses the document. Refused (Error::InvalidEncodedBytes).
Read by both: an encoding the decoder does not read. Refused as unsupported.
UTF-7: xmllint reads it, Saxon-HE does not support it. Refused as unsupported.
UTF-32LE without a byte order mark: Saxon-HE reads it, xmllint refuses it. Refused as unsupported (UCS-4, from the first bytes).
EBCDIC (code page 037), read by both: an encoding the decoder does not read. Refused as unsupported (from the first bytes).
